component_rules: Keep archived prototype discovery in one deterministic test helper; do not duplicate archive globbing across tests.
Keep WorkspaceController and immutable Python view models as a backend state reference; do not import them into the browser bundle.
Extract versioned DTO fixtures before Web and Tauri transports implement the same contract.
Extract operation-token and stale-result handling before more than one asynchronous action uses it.
Extract atomic source saving into an application/filesystem utility rather than React editor code.
Extract diagnostics zh-CN presentation mapping when a second UI surface needs the same stable issue mapping.
Extract renderer-neutral preview mapping when outline and paper preview share semantic ordering or labels.
Reuse inspect_service, validation_service, build_service and template resolver instead of copying domain behavior into UI.
Keep React components independent of HTTP, Tauri, Python, DOCX and OOXML implementation details.
Keep HTTP framework and sidecar protocol code inside transport adapters.
